geography.text: Data representative for a low energy building in Zurich, Switzerland

technology.text: Reduction of 34.2 MJ/(m2 a) heat demand representative for a low energy building in Zurich and a room temperature of 20°C. Heat demand of the building without ventilation system 105 MJ/(m2 a) according to SIA 380/1. Electricity demand of ventilator (0.4 Wh/m3) representative for DC- or EC-motors and a system design with low pressure drops. Electricity demand of control unit 10 W. Electricity mix for Switzerland used. Ventilation system including ground heat exchanger and 1 central ventilation unit with an air exchange rate of 720 m3/h. Distribution of fresh- and exhaust-air within the flat with polyethylene tubes (75 mm diameter).

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Calculations, technical information and assumptions. Data valid for example building used.
